summary: Preserve the alias break when module.exports is replaced but exports still references the old object.

target.notes: The later exports property write targets the old object, not the replacement module.exports.

semantics.alias_break: module.exports replacement does not mutate the exports local reference

caveats: The identifiers start with object identity but are not linked bindings.

tests.name: old exports write not on replacement
tests.input:
// a.cjs: module.exports={a:1}; exports.b=2
// main.cjs: const x=require('./a'); console.log(x.a,x.b);

tests.name: explicit re-alias works
tests.input:
// a.cjs: module.exports={a:1}; exports=module.exports; exports.b=2
// main.cjs: const x=require('./a'); console.log(x.a,x.b);
